تطبيق معدل API

A control that limits the number of API requests a client or application can make within a specific time frame to prevent abuse, denial of service, or resource exhaustion.

Definition

A control that limits the number of API requests a client or application can make within a specific time frame to prevent abuse, denial of service, or resource exhaustion.

Operational example

Implement API rate enforcement on all public endpoints to defend against brute-force attacks and API abuse by limiting request frequency.
